title: Oddness of the odd part
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$, the function $x\mapsto \bigl(f(x)-f(-x)\bigr)/2$ is odd; that is, its value at $-x$ is the negative of its value at $x$.
